## Invitations

Outreach activity recorded 2436 invitations during the reporting period. Of those invited, 729 attended, giving an attendance rate of 29.9. The figures provide a straightforward view of participation and indicate the level of engagement achieved through the invitation process.

Practical arrangements were maintained alongside the outreach activity. Van days were kept where roads allowed, supporting delivery in areas where road access permitted. This approach helped retain the planned outreach presence while recognising local travel conditions.

## Contact

Contact was supported through SMS messaging and reminder messages. A total of 2096 invitations went with an SMS, while 2096 people received a reminder message. Using both forms of contact provided a consistent way to reinforce the invitation and maintain contact with those invited.

The results and arrangements are recorded for local service review and future outreach planning. The report was prepared by G. Evans.
